mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has a negative Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns do not occur in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by low unemployment and strong labor market growth), a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals overheating and impending policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the regime condition (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 140000) despite rising CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: A stronger labor market (measured by higher nonfarm payrolls, PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS and 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1200 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of weak housing starts (HOUST < 1200) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) has a negative Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns do not occur in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong post-pandemic recovery regime (defined by GDP above 16000 billion dollars), a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures that prompt central bank intervention, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 16000 and CPIAUCSL is rising over a 5-year rolling window.
